meaning: To start to get to know people to avoid social awkwardness and formality.
usage_examples: Including a few fun details in large group introductions can be a great way to break the ice.

expression: hit the nail on the head
meaning: To identify something exactly; to arrive at exactly the right answer.
usage_examples: He hit the nail on the head when he said the problem was the thermostat.

expression: let the cat out of the bag
meaning: To disclose a secret; to let a secret be known, often inadvertently.
usage_examples: It was going to be a surprise party until someone let the cat out of the bag.

meaning: To fail to take advantage of an opportunity; to overlook or be too late to pursue an option or course of action.
usage_examples: The price discount ended yesterday and I just missed the boat on a great deal.

meaning: To tease someone; to lead someone on; to goad someone into overreacting. It usually implies teasing or goading by jokingly lying.
